messages:
Eli (Design): quick mock in figma: compact filter bar, pin-on-row, and micro-badge update. question: persist filters across compare nav & accessible labels for chips?
Sam (PM): users should return to the same filters after compare. support wants short links.
Noor (A11y): chips must be buttons with aria-pressed and an aria-label like 'Filter: architecture = llama'. if we auto-restore, announce via role="status".
Raj (Frontend): plan: URL token (short base64) for shares, localStorage for session restore. precedence: URL > local.
Eli (Design): show a subtle banner: 'Filters restored — Restore filters' with a clear button. label 'Clear filters' on left.
Sam (PM): pinning should be account-persistent for signed-in users, session for guests. tooltip: 'Pin this model version for comparisons'.
Noor (A11y): badges fail contrast at small sizes. recommend outline + icon, and add aria-label on badge container.
ops-bot: Reminder: short follow-up review tomorrow.
Eli (Design): will update figma and post A11y checklist link. Raj to share POC link for compact URL. resolving for now.
